status: proposed construction - calculated, not built or measured
construction: DMEGC EC39A DMR95 (ETD39 class), centre-leg gap 1.05 mm, 48:8 live:9 SELV in the order P1 | SH | SELV (TIW-litz) | LIVE | P2, copper set back 2.0 mm from the gapped leg, vacuum-potted case

acceptance_limits.note: routine-test limits that guarantee the drain-voltage budget (1336 V vs 1360 V): leakage measured at 100 kHz with SELV and live shorted; switched capacitance P1-start to shield at 100 kHz

electrical.cross_regulation: tightest practical band: SELV and live as adjacent single full-width layers, same winding sense, between the primary halves (P1 | SH | SELV | LIVE | P2), separated only by the reinforced tape barrier -> live-SELV leakage ~0.3 uH; bifilar SELV/live would halve it again but leaves only the TIW insulation (~25 kV/mm at the 2505 V pk PD test: not PD-free); a SELV-LIVE-SELV sandwich (~0.15 uH) needs a second reinforced barrier and does not fit the ETD39-class window; the residual band is set by the diode drops and the 18 W / 57 W load asymmetry - the converter engineer re-runs the band with these leakages

core.note: window and post from the ETD 39/20/13 class (MAS); the EC39A drawing is image-only - confirm the bobbin
core.asian_alternative: this is the Asian part (DMEGC lists no ETD39)

windings.name: P1
windings.spec: litz 30 x 0.10 mm (grade 2 strands), 1 layer, start = DRAIN

windings.name: SH
windings.spec: copper foil 0.05 mm, open overlap, -> BUS-

windings.name: SELV
windings.spec: TIW-litz 150 x 0.10 mm (three-layer extruded, certified reinforced), 1 layer

windings.name: LIVE
windings.spec: litz 100 x 0.10 mm, 1 layer, -> live 24 V rectifier

windings.name: P2
windings.spec: litz 30 x 0.10 mm, 1 layer, finish = bulk

insulation.system: VACUUM-POTTED case; REINFORCED SELV barrier = TIW-litz insulation + 4 x 0.06 mm tape each side of the SELV layer; primary, live, shield and core on the BUS- side (functional among themselves, PD-free 1750 V pk); SELV pins on their own row, creepage >= 20.0 mm PD2 / 6.4 mm potted, clearance >= 10.4 mm
insulation.routine_tests: <= 10 pC at 2505 Vpk on every unit (extinction >= 2004 Vpk)
insulation.type_tests: AC 4400.0 V rms 60 s; impulse 8000.0 V; thermal at 82.5 W

core.formula: unipolar DCM flux (iGSE), DMR95 at 100 C

winding.formula: 1-D Dowell ramp + line-source gap fringing per layer; live winding loaded with its power share

thermal.basis: potted ETD39-class case ~45 x 40 x 35 mm, ~12 K/W natural convection (estimate)

cost.basis: ESTIMATES, no quote: EC39A 70 g 0.85; former 0.45; TIW-litz 150 x 0.1 ~1.0 m 1.6; litz P + live 0.6, foil/tape 0.2; case + vacuum potting 1.6; winding 1.6; PD routine test 0.8; +10 %
